meta.name: talking-head-production
meta.description: Talking head video production with AI avatars, lipsync, and voiceover. Recommended: P-Video-Avatar (fastest, cheapest, built-in TTS). Also covers OmniHuman, PixVerse, Fabric. Portrait requirements, audio quality, production workflows. Use for: spokesperson videos, course content, social media, presentations, demos. Triggers: talking head, avatar video, lipsync, lip sync, ai spokesperson, virtual presenter, ai presenter, omnihuman, talking avatar, video presenter, ai talking head, presenter video, ai face video, p-video-avatar

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI数字人快速生成口播视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作带AI虚拟主播的视频内容
copy.tagline_en: Create talking head videos with AI avatars quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce spokesperson videos with AI avatars

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的肖像图片和文字脚本，调用 AI 模型生成说话头像视频，支持唇形同步、语音旁白和多种风格控制。
howto.when: 当你提到“talking head”、“avatar video”、“lipsync”等关键词，或要求制作发言人视频、课程内容、社交媒体视频时触发。

say.text: 用这张肖像图生成一段产品介绍视频，脚本是：欢迎来到我们的产品演示。
帮我用 OmniHuman 制作一个双人对话视频，音频文件在这里。
say.note: Claude 会使用 OmniHuman 1.5 模型处理。

say.text: 把这段视频翻译成西班牙语并重新生成唇形同步。
say.note: Claude 会执行多语言配音工作流。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate talking head videos with AI avatars, lipsync, and voiceover based on your portrait image and text script, supporting style control and multi-language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "talking head", "avatar video", "lipsync", or request spokesperson videos, course content, social media videos, etc.

say_en.text: Generate a product intro video using this portrait and script: Welcome to our demo.
Create a two-person conversation video with OmniHuman, audio file attached.
Dub this video into Spanish with lipsync.
say_en.note: Claude will run multilingual dubbing workflow.
